name: sidebar-right-panel
title: Sidebar: Right details panel
description: A support inbox: nav on the left, the picked conversation's details in a sidebar on the right.
author: DressCode UI <https://dresscodeui.com>

files.content:
"use client" // Two sidebars: the app's nav on the left (folds to icons) and a details panel on the right // (side="right") for a support inbox. Folders and labels filter the list; picking a conversation fills // the panel, where its status, priority and owner can be changed. Arrow keys move through the list. // On phones the panel opens as a sheet from the right. The details panel has its own SidebarProvider, // controlled from the header button, so Ctrl/⌘ B still folds only the nav. // It sits in a 640px frame here: in your app, drop the frame classes on the outer SidebarProvider and // "absolute h-full" on both sidebars so they fill the window. import * as React from "react" import { AlarmClock, AtSign, CheckCheck, Inbox, LifeBuoy, PanelRight, Reply, Settings, UserRound, X } from "lucide-react" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@/components/ui/avatar" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator } from "@/components/ui/breadcrumb" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select" import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator" import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupContent, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarHeader, SidebarInset, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuBadge, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarProvider, SidebarRail, SidebarSeparator, SidebarTrigger, useSidebar, } from "@/components/ui/sidebar" import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tooltip" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" type Status = "Open" | "Pending" | "Closed" type Priority = "Low" | "Normal" | "High" type LabelId = "billing" | "bug" | "feature" type Conversation = { id: string name: string email: string company: string plan: string since: string invoices: number subject: string body: string[] time: string unread: boolean mentioned?: boolean snoozed?: string labels: LabelId[] assignee: string priority: Priority status: Status } const ME = "Ada Lin" const TEAM = ["Unassigned", "Ada Lin", "Sam Reid", "Mei Chen"] const LABELS: { id: LabelId; title: string; dot: string }[] = [ { id: "billing", title: "Billing", dot: "bg-(--chart-1)" }, { id: "bug", title: "Bug", dot: "bg-(--chart-5)" }, { id: "feature", title: "Feature request", dot: "bg-(--chart-4)" }, ] const INITIAL: Conversation[] = [ { id: "c1", name: "Priya Nair", email: "priya@fernwood.studio", company: "Fernwood Studio", plan: "Pro, yearly", since: "March 2024", invoices: 312, subject: "Card declined on our renewal", body: [ "Hi, our card was declined this morning when the Pro plan renewed. We've added a new card since.", "Can you retry the charge? Our reminders are paused and two clients are already late.", ], time: "9:41", unread: true, labels: ["billing"], assignee: "Ada Lin", priority: "High", status: "Open", }, { id: "c2", name: "Tom Okafor", email: "tom@katolee.co", company: "Kato & Lee", plan: "Team, monthly", since: "June 2025", invoices: 87, subject: "Can clients pay in two installments?", body: ["A few of our bigger clients asked to split payments. Nothing changed on our side as far as I know."], time: "Yesterday", unread: false, labels: ["bug"], assignee: "Ada Lin", priority: "High", status: "Open", }, { id: "c4", name: "Leo Martins", email: "leo@juniperbakery.com", company: "Juniper Bakery", plan: "Free", since: "October 2026", invoices: 6, subject: "How do I add VAT to an invoice?", body: ["We just registered for VAT. @Ada Lin said there's a setting for it but I can't find where to turn it on."], time: "Yesterday", unread: false, mentioned: true, labels: ["billing"], assignee: "Sam Reid", priority: "Low", status: "Pending", }, { id: "c5", name: "Hana Sato", email: "hana@northfield.co", company: "Northfield Co.", plan: "Pro, yearly", since: "August 2023", invoices: 506, subject: "Export every invoice for our accountant", body: ["Our accountant needs all invoices from this tax year as PDFs, ideally in one file. No rush, the deadline is in January."], time: "Mon", unread: false, snoozed: "Thursday", labels: [], assignee: "Ada Lin", priority: "Normal", status: "Pending", }, { id: "c6", name: "Oliver Brandt", email: "oliver@tessellate.dev", company: "Tessellate Labs", plan: "Team, yearly", since: "May 2024", invoices: 221, subject: "Thanks, the payout arrived", body: ["All good now, the payout landed this morning. Thanks for chasing the bank."], time: "Nov 20", unread: false, labels: ["billing"], assignee: "Mei Chen", priority: "Normal", status: "Closed", }, ] type Filter = { kind: "folder"; id: "inbox" | "mine" | "mentions" | "snoozed" | "done" } | { kind: "label"; id: LabelId } const FOLDERS = [ { id: "inbox" as const, title: "Inbox", icon: Inbox }, { id: "mine" as const, title: "Assigned to me", icon: UserRound }, { id: "mentions" as const, title: "Mentions", icon: AtSign }, { id: "snoozed" as const, title: "Snoozed", icon: AlarmClock }, { id: "done" as const, title: "Done", icon: CheckCheck }, ] const ignore = () => {} const isOpen = (c: Conversation) => c.status !== "Closed" && !c.snoozed function inFilter(c: Conversation, f: Filter) { if (f.kind === "label") return c.labels.includes(f.id) && c.status !== "Closed" if (f.id === "inbox") return isOpen(c) if (f.id === "mine") return isOpen(c) && c.assignee === ME if (f.id === "mentions") return !!c.mentioned && c.status !== "Closed" if (f.id === "snoozed") return !!c.snoozed && c.status !== "Closed" return c.status === "Closed" } const filterTitle = (f: Filter) => (f.kind === "folder" ?
